baselineObserved.provenance: Executed before local data corrections in this recovery checkpoint; not recomputed from unavailable prior Library checkpoint.

scope: Integrated working-tree catalog after preparation; fixed remote baseline and current HEAD are provenance, not immutable copies of modified files.

requirements: all mapped titles exactly match cited source titles

limitations: Structural qualification does not verify URL availability, source authenticity, claim entailment, or numerical calibration.
Name/alias normalization detects literal collisions; semantic ideology distinctness and regime-period overlap require human source review.
Current category indicates a contemporary snapshot, not that every policy or constitution remains current on execution date.
Expansion preparation has already centered and removed unsupported axes; this inventory does not recover discarded raw estimates.
